name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 9 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2026-07-17, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.64 µm. The pipeline found 3 moving objects.
